g0.rationale: 4-in-1 multi-use. Mask mode: after washing, 2–3 min, rinse → qualifies. Pre-shampoo mode (not after cleansing), Spülung mode (no stated contact time) and leave-in mode (not rinsed) do not. Exactly one qualifying mode → classified mode-scoped (§2.2 step 3).
evidenceSignals: mask mode: 'Nach dem Waschen … 2 bis 3 Minuten einwirken lassen, gründlich ausspülen'

tailMarker.note: Earliest tail-class species PARFUM @13. Architecture species (Cetearyl Alcohol @2, cationics @4/@5/@7, Isopropyl Myristate @6) all outrank it; allergens and parabens follow. Plausible.

conditioningLevel.rationale: S1: Behentrimonium Chloride @4, Distearoylethyl Hydroxyethylmonium Methosulfate @5, Behenamidopropyl Dimethylamine @7 (3 species). S2: Cetearyl Alcohol @2. S3: Isopropyl Myristate @6 + Glycosphingolipids @10 (R4a). S1+S2 without dependence on the boundary species, plausible marker, no material counter-signal → high.

weightPotential.rationale: No R4b above the marker (Isopropyl Myristate @6 is a light ester; Shea @15 and Apricot Kernel Oil @18 are in the tail) → high unavailable. Leanness test fails conjunct 3: three cationic species on the full list. → moderate.
evidenceSignals: no occlusive silicone stack (Amodimethicone @14 single, in tail)
counterSignals: 3 cationic species on full list block low

careDirection.rationale: Material R5 route: Hydrolyzed Silk @11 + Sericin @12, two distinct qualifying species above PARFUM @13. Humectant cluster absent (Glycerin @3 only above tail) → not balanced (a) → protein. Sericin @12 is at tail_index−1 and load-bearing (without it, a single R5 at @11 fails the rank-8 test → moisture), so confidence capped at moderate (E8); D4 heavy payload (multiple R5 above tail) caps it at moderate too. Gluconamide tokens are not counted as R5 (§6 rule 4).

repairSupportLevel.rationale: bond_route gluconamide: Hydroxypropylgluconamide @8 + Hydroxypropylammonium Gluconate @9, the named pair, both above PARFUM @13 on a plausible marker → high. Comparative formula potential only: none of the bond routes has strong independent product-level substantiation at drugstore concentrations, and gluconamide bonding's own literature reports the hair mechanism as unknown.
counterSignals: amino silicone (Amodimethicone @14) is never bond evidence

primaryFocus.rationale: Step 3 repair clears on R7 named bond chemistry (gluconamide pair @8–9) plus a distinct R5 film route (@11–12); 'Bonding' positioning corroborates only. Shine lost: 'Glanz' positioning but no above-tail R2/R3 optical route (Amodimethicone @14 is in the tail). focus_care_verdict: repair_supported; claim_role: corroborating.
counterSignals: 'Liquid Silk Glanz' positioning without optical architecture

secondaryFocus.rationale: No secondary: no humectant cluster; shine fails criterion 1 (no above-tail R2/R3); smoothing has no above-tail silicone/polymer beyond baseline.
